summary: Plan revision 11 and all five registered design documents are consistent for this bounded synthetic, read-only increment. Both new regression requirements concretize existing normative contracts without requiring design-document amendments. BOM preservation enforces strict JSON parsing before code consumption; complete snapshot validation prevents valid separate events from masking an invalid snapshot. Parent BB-01..10 and runtime handler/effect-counter obligations remain explicitly pending. All registered document hashes match, and the harness review binding remained unchanged at completion.

assessment: The decoded pair body must retain its BOM so strict JSON parsing rejects the body with 400 REQUEST_INVALID before credential evaluation or code consumption. The successful retry with the same code demonstrates intended non-consumption.

The client contract requires the snapshot endpoint to return a SyntheticSnapshotSchema object. Its events field is required, non-nullable and structurally validated. Revision 11 correctly requires complete snapshot validation before overlaying separately validated events.
Missing, null or malformed snapshot events remain recoverable read failures even when /events returns a valid array; unvalidated data cannot establish connected state.
Existing operation-specific transitions, focus rules, stale-response suppression and memory-only credential boundaries remain coherent with the new requirements.
Synthetic-state equality and static absence-of-call-site review are partial evidence and do not replace parent BB-02/BB-09 counters, complete BB-01..10 or OS isolation.

No tests, builds, services, browser sessions or runtime probes were executed.
